findings.title: Raw-count scan is not scoped to the product's shape
findings.description:
`raw_counts` counts every `tick_trade` row in the session window, grouped by instrument. It has no filter for the product's dataset, symbols or instruments. `ledger_totals` is filtered by `Shape`. `_session_row` in `tick_coverage.py` takes the union of instruments from both maps. Any instrument that belongs to another product therefore shows up with ledger 0 and raw N, and is reported as a mismatch. `build_coverage` would then exit 3 spuriously.

`TICK_UNIVERSE` currently holds only ES (`universe.py:46`), so this does not bite today. It will as soon as a second product is added. Either restrict the raw scan to the product's instruments, or document and test the single-product assumption.

findings.title: Module-level `assert` used as the exhaustiveness guard
findings.description: The check that `_BUCKET_ROWS` covers every `TickSessionStatus` is a bare `assert`. It is stripped under `python -O`, and it raises `AssertionError` at import time, which would break the whole CLI. A unit test asserting the same equality would enforce it without the import-time risk. The test file has no such test.

findings.title: Duplicate `shape_units` query and O(n²) filtering in status build
findings.description: `_scope` calls `shape_units(conn, shape_of(entry))`. `session_verdicts` then calls it again for the same product, so each product pays for the same query twice. `[c for c in lines if c not in spreads]` is a list-membership test using dataclass equality, which is quadratic in contract count. Filtering on `c.instrument_class != SPREAD_CLASS` would avoid it. Neither issue is severe, but both are easy to fix. Pass the fetched units through, and filter on the class directly.

findings.title: Structure and style
findings.description:
- The function-local imports in the new verbs and helpers (`_entries`, `_read`, `_read_storage`) hide dependencies. Check that they match the file's existing convention.
- `_read_storage()` exists only to defer one import.
- `tick_coverage` validates `end <= start` before `run_mapped`, which is fine. `tick_status_render.py` and the `tick_status_build.py` public functions lack docstrings (`age`, `print_status`, `jsonable`, `build_status`).
- I found no `[tool.pyright]` block in `pyproject.toml` (only ruff matched my grep). That is outside this diff, but the Python rules require it.

findings.title: Tests and refactor hygiene
findings.description:
The new integration tests cover the following:
- status and coverage output, including `--json`
- a mismatch exiting 3
- preflight refusals exiting 1
- an unreachable database exiting 4
- builds against real ingested data

`days_touched` and `utc_midnight` were extracted from `session_days.py` and `ingest_plan.py` without changing behavior. `TickDatabaseUnreachable` subclasses `TickPreflightError`, so existing handlers keep working. The test fixtures use throwaway databases, and the `DELETE`s target only those.
